ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour distribution map; at the bottom, longitude about 121°30′E can be seen, at the upper right, latitude about 28°30′N can be seen, and the right side is labeled “perennial water area”. Point A is located in the left part of the figure where mountain contour lines are relatively dense, and point B is located at the lower right, on the lowland side near the perennial water area. Looking along the direction from A to B, the contour lines near A are dense and the slope is relatively steep; continuing toward B, the contour lines become relatively sparse, belonging to a hilly gentle slope; farther to the lower right it approaches the plain lowland and the vicinity of the water area. Then reason: The latitude-longitude and the location of the perennial water area of this place indicate that it belongs to the southeastern subtropical coastal region of China. The line from A to B can be divided according to terrain and agricultural suitability into four sections: mountain steep slope, hilly gentle slope, plain lowland, and vicinity of water area. The first section of steep slope is suitable for ecological forest; the second section is after the steep slope and before the plain lowland, and is a subtropical hilly gentle slope, suitable for developing citrus orchards. Therefore, the second section from A to B should be arranged as an orange orchard.
